'''Yesgar''' was the leader of a [[Yesgar's pirates|group of pirates]] that operated during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They could be found on the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Antared III]], [[Durollia]], [[Hermos]], and [[Pegg]].
